changes: Authority client protected GET reads now require the configured customer API key: listJobVerdicts and authority_job_status send Authorization, while policy discovery remains keyless and missing keys fail closed before fetch.
usage: Run authority_job_status or authority_verdict_list with LATTICE_AUTHORITY_CUSTOMER_API_KEY configured; public authority policy discovery does not require that key.
expectedOutcome: CLI status reads against a protected Authority Server endpoint should no longer 401 when a customer API key is configured, and should still avoid claiming authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone without receipt plus quorum.
actualTranscript: npm --prefix packages/main run build passed; node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-client-smoke.js printed authority client smoke passed; node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-completion-smoke.js printed authority completion smoke passed; DONE pre-check shows review assurance floor full-3x2.
outcomeDiff: No behavior diff from expected: protected GETs carry Authorization, missing-key paths fail closed locally, and read success alone remains blocked from authority completion.
limitations: Does not create runner verdict quorum or gate_decision receipts by itself; it only fixes authenticated protected read behavior.
pitfalls: Main moved twice during TEST, which made evidence and host verdict material hashes stale; refreshed validation and rebound fresh local review verdicts to the current material hash.
